TOPPING HACK! THIS IS IMPORTANT FOR THOSE SCARED TO TRY!
item.description: Topping plants is a really scary thing to do, especially when you finally see growth, everything looks healthy and you feel like you finally got it going. Cutting the head off sounds crazy, but trust it is not. Not cutting the heads leads to tall lanky and not very fruitful plants. They stretch more then they produce. Topping them, keeps them shorter and makes them grow bushier, outward. When you cut the top off, all the other branches will fight to be the top branch, which creates a bushier fuller plant. Don’t be scared, TOP YOUR PLANTS, WATCH THE DIFFERENCE!! • Thank you to @frecklesandsprouts from TikTok for this amazing content. • Please give frecklesandsprouts a follow on tik tok.

item.title: Top 3 Tips for Growing Juicy, Productive Tomatoes 🍅🌱
item.description: Ready to grow the tastiest tomatoes in your garden? Follow these top three tips to enjoy a bumper crop of juicy, homegrown goodness: Bathe in Sunlight 🌞 – Tomatoes are sun-lovers! Give them at least 6-8 hours of bright sunlight for vibrant, flavorful fruit. More sun = sweeter tomatoes! Master the Art of Watering 💧 – Keep soil moist but never soggy.
